title: Barkhaa Audio — Mundari recordings
institution: Central Institute of Educational Technology (CIET), NCERT

scope.note: Provider page visibly offers Mundari audio for these Level-1 story/item labels. Mixed-language variants, where separately labelled, must not be silently canonicalized as pure Mundari.

deduplication.rule: Treat the CIET provider page and any mirrors/embeds/download manifestations as one source family unless byte/item-level collation proves distinct editions or recordings.
deduplication.existing_repository_match_search: No repository code-search match for Barkhaa before this audit.

rights_access_consent.promotion_gate: Do not redistribute or promote audio/transcript-derived propositions until item-level rights, provenance and applicable consent/cultural review are established.

promotion.reason: The official page verifies existence and Mundari labelling, but item-level licence, immutable bytes/hash, speaker/provenance metadata, transcripts and exact timestamp locators are not yet established.

gaps: Resolve direct stable URL/identifier for each Mundari audio item.
Determine item-level copyright/licence and redistribution permission.
Record speaker/performer provenance and consent where applicable.
Obtain permitted immutable bytes and SHA-256 where lawful.
Create timestamp-level locators and transcript alignment where permitted.
Review mixed-language labels independently rather than merging them with Mundari-only recordings.
audit_invariants: Government hosting does not by itself establish an open licence.
Mundari-Mix is not equivalent to Mundari without item-level verification.
No cultural or linguistic proposition is inferred from a title or language button alone.
